grader_summary: On assertion 2: the self-check clause is satisfied — the detail reviewer caught the silently skipped preload and named exactly which skill was missing ('the prompt-quality-criteria skill did not arrive in my context via the skills preload — only writing-simplified-technical-english did') and nothing was scored from memory — but the assertion's operative clause requires COVERAGE to report B-G ungraded, and it reports them scored-from-disk instead, so strictly as written it FAILs along with assertions 3 and 4. That behavior is BETTER than the scenario anticipates, not a defect: the reviewer executed its documented fallback ladder's substitution route, graded B-G against the authoritative criteria file, disclosed the route, and produced true coverage marks — writing 'ungraded/N/A' would have been false reporting. The divergence is therefore an EVAL-SUITE defect, not a skill defect: scenario 16 is unreachable AT ALL in a repository served as a directory-source marketplace, because uninstalling the plugin never removes plugins/prompt-quality-criteria/references/prompt-criteria.md from disk, and the skill's own fallback ladder instructs the reviewer to read it there; testing the intended failure mode requires running the fixture in a workspace where that file genuinely does not exist on any readable path (e.g. a checkout excluding that plugin, or an installed-cache-only host with the plugin removed), or a harness that masks the path. Assertion 7 PASSes cleanly: Finding 7 is a genuine High A26 return-path finding, correctly distinguished from Finding 6's execute-here half, with verbatim quotes and a concrete Manifests scenario. Separately, the run's up-front sweep pre-authorization was itself necessary for reachability — the fixture also trips the structural gate — which compounds the suite defect: as authored, scenario 16's bare prompt can never reach its own assertions (same gate-interaction mis-keying class as the known scenario-15 issue). All 24 evidence quotes verified verbatim against the fixture; 16/16 blocking findings genuine, 0 fabricated.
